title: Samiddhi
text: 3 Loko lokoti bhante vuccati || Kittāvatā nu kho bhante loko vā assa lokapaññatti vā ti || || 4-9 Yattha kho Samiddhi atthi cakkhum atthi rūpā atthi cakkhuviññāṇam atthi cakkhuviññāṇaviññātabbā dhammā || atthi tattha loko vā lokapaññatti vā || || la || || [page 040] 40 SAḶĀYATANA-SAṂYUTTA [XXXV. 68. 10 Atthi mano atthi dhammā atthi manoviññāṇaṃ atthi manoviññāṇaviññātabbā dhammā || atthi tattha loko vā lokapaññatti vā || || 10-15 Yattha ca kho Samiddhi natthi cakkhu natthi rūpā natthi cakkhuviññāṇam natthi cakkhuviññāṇaviññātabbā dhammā || natthi tattha loko vā lokapaññatti vā || || la || || natthi jivhā natthi rasā || pe || natthi mano natthi dhammā natthi manoviññāṇaṃ natthi manoviññāṇaviññātabbā dhammā || natthi tattha loko vā lokapaññatti vā ti || ||
